component.name: noteAppC
component.summary: Markdown notes and Obsidian vaults, native and fast

description.p: noteAppC reads and edits Markdown notes and Obsidian vaults in a native Qt application: live preview, wikilinks and backlinks, search, tags, callouts, tables, maths, the graph view, canvases and bases, in tabs and splits.
A vault stays Obsidian's: settings, hotkeys, bookmarks and layouts are read from its .obsidian folder and never written back, and a note is only ever changed where it was edited.
